"5. Service and payment risks\nChanges in networks, platform interfaces, system compatibility, device status, or operator maintenance may cause login failures, quote changes, delayed payment status, or devices failing to start. The author does not guarantee permanent availability, error-free operation, or device startup. Before paying, verify the device, item, amount, and payment channel. If results are unexpected, check the order or contact the operator before paying again. Fulfillment, refunds, and disputes are governed by the relevant service providers' valid rules and applicable law."

"2. Your account and lawful authorization\nOnly operate accounts, device services, and orders that belong to you or for which you have lawful authorization. Do not impersonate others, use their verification codes, steal tokens, or misuse payment accounts. Do not access, save, or disclose others' account, order, device usage, or personal information without authorization."

"8. No impersonation, fraudulent fees, or misleading claims\nDo not impersonate the author, operator, or administrators to sell nonexistent permissions, guarantee washing results, promise special privileges, solicit transfers, or commit other fraud. The author's client is free; voluntary donations do not affect features or normal use. Rights and obligations for lawful derivatives remain governed by the applicable licenses. Do not imply endorsement by the author or original platform in publicity."

"10. Stop when something is wrong\nIf prices, orders, payments, or device status are unexpected, stop repeating actions, verify through order queries, the original platform, or the operator, and provide redacted information to the feedback group. Do not exploit errors for further gain, expand testing without permission, or disclose others' sensitive data. Business disputes with the platform or operator should go through their official channels."

Actual service charges for laundry, account balance, and third-party payments are governed by legitimate orders shown by the operator and payment channel. Free software does not mean free laundry. Fees charged elsewhere are not the author's software fees."
